answer: Each nodule claim is surveyed by weighing the nodules dredged from the plot and marking the weight on the claim chart. A marble weight copied from another claim fails the chart: at the dune of the plot the nodules must match the dredge's own haul, and a copied weight claims nodules from another seabed. Forging a claim takes a dredge, a survey crew and 33,400 in vessel time, while the shale chart in the claims office is kept until the claim lapses, so a plot whose nodules were never weighed is cancelled.
